mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 80 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library, and we are currently in the third quarter moon phase.

The City of Verona has some great updates today. The Senior Center is launching a free tri-shaw bike program for community members, while the Recreation Department is currently seeking applicants for seasonal roles like adult fitness instructors.

Today, you can head to Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee for trivia nights. Tomorrow, the downtown farmer's market kicks off at Hometown Junction Park, and we also have yoga at Insight Wellness and Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory.

Regarding local police activity, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop for an equipment violation, which resulted in the driver being arrested for O W I and cited for suspended vehicle registration.
It is a great day to visit Culver's because the flavor of the day is Butter Pecan. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
